historyDeleteWarning: Permanently delete the selected conversation? This action cannot be undone.
historyPrivacy: Stored locally by the host, including messages, images and provider states; not encrypted. Opening or searching never calls the API. To continue, select the same provider and model. Another model starts a new conversation.
historyInterruptedTurn: Response interrupted. Check history to see what was saved.
historyCancelledTurn: Cancelled turn · retained in history, never replayed to the provider.
historyFailedTurn: Incomplete turn · retained in history, never replayed to the provider.
historyErrorCorrupt: Invalid history file. Nothing was overwritten; check the local file before retrying.
historyErrorSize: History exceeds the storage or read limit. Open a smaller conversation or start a new one.
historyErrorWrite: History could not be saved. Check disk access and free space; the received response remains visible.
historyErrorMissing: Conversation not found on disk. Search history again.
previewDetail: Browser preview: the C# bridge is unavailable. Sending is disabled; no connection has been simulated.
connectingDetail: Waiting for a real response from the C# host.
connectedDetail: The C# host responded. Configure a provider in the BYOK panel to chat with your models.
failedDetail: The bridge could not be validated. Reconnect or reopen the tool window.
externalLinkBlocked: External links are not opened in this tool window.
error_invalid_message: The host rejected the message: invalid format.
error_invalid_response: Bridge response rejected: invalid format or correlation.
error_timeout: The host did not respond within 8 seconds. Your text was preserved.
error_bridge_unavailable: The C# bridge is unavailable. Reopen the tool window to try again.
error_bridge_busy: Wait for the previous message to finish.
error_payload_too_large: The message exceeds the host's size limit.
error_unknown_type: The host did not recognize the message type.
error_unsupported_version: The host did not recognize the message version.
error_unknown: The host reported an error. Your text was preserved.
byokUrlHelp: HTTPS required; HTTP is allowed only on loopback. No credentials or query parameters in the URL.
byokKey: API key (optional for public / local catalogs)
byokKeyHelp: Sent only to the native C# bridge; cleared on submission. Credentials are stored by the host, never in browser storage.
byokDeploymentsHelp: One name per line. Azure chat uses deployment names, not model IDs.
byokListingNote: Test / list only discovers models. No paid chat or capability probing.
byokOverrideHelp: Set all three values explicitly. Unknown is not confirmed false. This is a session override, not a paid probe; rediscovery may replace it.
byokProbeHelp: Select a model from OpenAI, OpenRouter, LM Studio or Azure. Only the chosen capability is verified when you click Verify; reasoning is never probed. Consent is cleared after each operation or model change.
byokProbeSupported: Verification confirmed support. Badges show the retained capability evidence.
byokProbeUnsupported: Verification confirmed no support. Badges show the retained capability evidence.
byokProbeInconclusive: Verification inconclusive. Capabilities were not changed.
byokEmpty: No conversation yet. Configure a provider in the BYOK panel, choose a model and send your first message.
byokNoModel: No model selected · open Providers · BYOK to choose
byokChatHint: Ctrl+Enter sends · Enter adds a line. Tool calls are display-only unless you consent to automatic tools for this send.
byokModeHelp: Ask answers; Plan creates a plan without changing files or running commands; Agent can act with the consent below.
byokAutoReadConsent: Allow automatic read-only tools for this send
byokAutoWriteConsent: Allow file create/edit for this send
byokAutoTerminalConsent: Allow terminal commands for this send
byokAutoToolsDetails: Automatic tools · privacy, approval and token limits
byokAutoWriteHelp: The model will be able to create and edit files. Inside the open solution changes apply automatically, with a visible diff and batch undo in the write panel; outside the workspace every write requires your explicit approval in chat. Open editor buffers are changed without saving to disk. Automatic continuation may consume paid tokens; the same per-send limits above apply. Consent resets after sending or changing model/configuration.
byokAutoTerminalHelp: The model can request cmd, PowerShell or bash commands, .NET builds and tests; builds and tests may execute code and access the network. Every command requires your explicit approval in chat: deny, allow once, or always allow this session; session permission is revoked when the solution changes or the bridge disconnects. The command blocklist is defense in depth, not a replacement for approval. Arguments are passed as a list, never concatenated; output appears in the Lumen pane of Visual Studio. Automatic continuation may consume paid tokens; the same per-send limits above apply. Consent resets after sending or changing model/configuration.
byokAutoReadHelp: The selected provider may receive file contents from the open solution, including unsaved editor buffers through get_edit_snapshot, Visual Studio errors and active Output, and installed shell paths. These may contain sensitive information. Read tools do not edit files or run commands. Automatic continuation may consume paid tokens. Per send: at most 4 provider calls (including the initial call), 8 tools, 8,192 requested output tokens and a 2-minute deadline. Consent resets after sending or changing model/configuration. Results are saved locally as unencrypted plain text. The separate manual disk panel never sends its results.
byokToolCompleted: Tool completed · result ready for provider
byokToolFailed: Tool failed · error ready for provider
byokErrorToolBudget: Automatic tool/token budget or deadline reached. Reduce the scope and send again manually; no automatic retry.
byokImageHelp: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF · up to 4 MB · only with vision enabled. No preview; changing models removes the image.
byokCost: Sending makes a real provider request and may consume credits, including reasoning tokens. Send only if you agree to that cost. Listing is not a paid chat.
byokDisconnected: Native bridge not connected. Configuration and provider chat are disabled; no browser connection is simulated.
byokReady: Connected to the native bridge. Open this panel or reload providers to list saved configurations.
byokEmptyProviders: No saved providers. Add one above to discover models.
byokCatalogReady: Models loaded. Select a model before sending.
byokCatalogUnverified: Catalog loaded; API key has not been verified.
byokSelected: Model selected. Sending requires your agreement to the cost note.
byokCredentialValid: The provider accepted the credential. No chat was sent.
byokToolNotice: Tool call · executes only with consent
byokToolEnded: Arguments received · executes only with consent
approvalPending: Waiting for your decision · Deny is the safe default
approvalExpired: Request expired · chat ended or bridge unavailable
approvalErrorDenied: Execution denied at approval. Nothing was changed.
commandErrorBlocked: Command blocked by the safety policy.
commandErrorTimeout: The command exceeded its time limit and was stopped.
commandErrorFailed: The command failed to start or run.
byokErrorInvalidKey: 401 · Invalid API key. Enter a valid key and test the listing again.
byokErrorPermission: 403 · Permission denied. Check provider / model access; this is not necessarily an invalid key.
byokErrorUrl: 404 / invalid URL · Check the base URL and deployment names, not just the key.
byokErrorRate: 429 · Rate limited. Wait before retrying; this does not mean the key is invalid.
byokErrorRateWait: 429 · Rate limited. The provider asked to wait {seconds} s before retrying; this does not mean the key is invalid.
byokErrorCredit: 402 · Insufficient credits. Check your provider balance before retrying.
byokErrorTimeout: The host did not finish within 120 seconds. Cancel any active request before retrying.
byokErrorBridge: Native bridge unavailable. Reconnect or reopen the tool window.
byokErrorBusy: The host is busy. Wait for the current request, or cancel the chat.
byokErrorFormat: Invalid bridge message or correlation. Reload providers to try again.
byokErrorImageType: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF file with matching image content.
byokErrorImageSize: Image exceeds 4 MB. Choose a smaller file.
byokErrorVision: The selected model does not have vision enabled. Select another model or review the manual override.
byokErrorNetwork: The provider could not be reached. Check its URL, local server and connection.
contextPath: File path relative to the loaded solution / reference
contextHelp: Explicit snapshots only: an empty file path captures the active file, including unsaved editor buffers. Selection uses the editor; Output uses the active pane. @solution is an inventory, not all file contents. Type a path, @file / @arquivo path or @solution / @solução here, then attach explicitly; typing never reads or sends. Up to 8 snapshots, 64K characters each / 128K total. Review plain-text previews and remove sensitive context before Send. The native host owns snapshots; only Send passes their content to the provider. Conversation history is saved locally as unencrypted plain text. New drafts retain attachments; changes do not refresh snapshots automatically.
contextCaptured: Snapshot attached. Review it before sending.
contextReleased: Snapshot removed from the native host.
contextErrorUnavailable: Context unavailable. Open a solution, file, selection or Output pane and attach explicitly again.
contextErrorOutside: The reference is outside the loaded solution. Choose a workspace-relative path.
contextErrorSize: Context exceeds 8 snapshots, 64K characters each or 128K total. Remove attachments or select less text.
contextErrorStale: The native snapshot is no longer available. Remove it and explicitly attach a new snapshot before retrying.
byokErrorUnknown: The host reported an error. Review the provider configuration and retry; raw provider errors are not displayed.
readToolsHelp: Explicit read-only disk tools for the open solution. Unsaved editor buffers are not read. No provider, tokens or automatic model invocation; results are not sent to the model or added to chat/context.
readToolsGlob: Relative glob (required for find_files; optional for grep)
readToolsLimits: Limits: 1 MiB/file, search up to 4 MiB, 1,024 entries / 32 levels, 256 results, 65,536 output characters. JSON reports truncation and skipped binary/large files. Narrow the path, lines or search when limited.
readToolsIdle: Ready when connected to Visual Studio; an open solution is required.
readToolsSucceeded: Success — disk result below. Not sent to the model.
readToolsErrorUnknown: The host rejected the disk read. Check the open solution and request; raw errors are not displayed.
readToolsErrorArguments: Choose a read-only tool and check its arguments and limits.
readToolsErrorPath: Path is invalid or unavailable. Check the solution-relative path on disk.
readToolsErrorOutside: Access outside the solution was rejected.
readToolsErrorWorkspace: Open a solution in Visual Studio and retry.
readToolsErrorSize: File or output exceeds the read limits. Narrow the request.
readToolsErrorBinary: The file is not supported UTF-8/UTF-16 text.
writeToolsHelp: Apply writes directly within the open solution. Open documents change the unsaved editor buffer with Visual Studio undo; closed files change on disk. No paid requests; content and results are not sent to the model or added to chat/context.
writeToolsLimits: Relative file path: up to 1,024 characters. Complete content: up to 65,536 characters. Only create_file and edit_file; no terminal or automatic model writes. The native host validates access.
writeToolsSession: Undo reverts only the latest batch: one model turn or consecutive manual writes, preserving earlier batches. Up to 64 changes are kept in memory for this native session only; undo is not saved in history. Review the diff below for a manual write or in the tool card for an automatic write.
writeToolsIdle: Choose a file and apply explicitly; an open solution is required.
writeToolsSucceeded: Applied — plain diff below. Not sent to the model.
writeToolsPending: Writes pending undo: {count} / 64. Undo reverts the latest batch.
writeToolsPendingUnknown: Undo status unknown. Open this panel or refresh status when connected.
writeToolsDiff: Applied file diff (plain text with + additions and - removals)
writeToolsDiffTruncated: Partial diff: {before} lines before, {after} after. Some changes are omitted.
writeToolsDiffTooLarge: Diff too large to display: {before} lines before, {after} after. Inspect the file in Visual Studio.
writeToolsErrorArguments: Choose create_file or edit_file and check the relative path and content limits.
writeToolsErrorExists: The file already exists. Use edit_file explicitly to replace its content.
writeToolsErrorUndo: The batch could not be fully undone. Review the files and refresh undo status; no automatic retry.
writeToolsErrorConflict: The file changed or conflicts with the batch. Review it in Visual Studio before applying or undoing again.
writeToolsErrorMode: The native host denied writing in the current mode.
writeToolsErrorUnknown: The native host rejected the request. Check the solution and file; raw errors are not displayed.
